sudan_governor_general_1899.source_title: Governor-General of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan: personal flag afloat
sudan_governor_general_1899.evidence_note: Flag Institute badge index dates Sudan governor to 1899; FOTW describes the personal flag afloat. SVG is a modern reconstruction; typography is not a 1900 facsimile.

bsac_company_1893.source_title: British South Africa Company: Union Flag with company crest
bsac_company_1893.evidence_note: Berry records the company flag at Bulawayo in 1893. Red ring and lettering differ among surviving variants; selected SVG is a reconstruction, not proof of one unique exact design. Excludes 1902 ensigns.

natal_colonial_1905.source_title: Natal: later simplified badge Blue Ensign, approximate map representative
natal_colonial_1905.evidence_note: FOTW archival correspondence CO 323/326 places replacement of the original Public Seal badge in 1905, despite misleading SVG filename. Later same-colony Blue Ensign represents administrative continuity; not claimed as exact 1900 flag.

india_governor_general_1885.evidence_note: Museum specimen AAA0271 supports Governor-General standard. Full Union Flag with Star of India and crown; SVG is a modern reconstruction.

algeria_colonial_ensign.source_title: French Algeria: reported colonial / naval double-tricolour ensign
algeria_colonial_ensign.evidence_note: Reported double-tricolour ensign: Commons cites 1844 Dictionary of Trade, Commerce and Navigation and 1908 cigarette card. This is a representative maritime colonial visual, not proof of universal official land use on 1900-01-01. Not the erroneous blue flag with French canton.

egypt_administration_pre1914.evidence_note: Egyptian public flag in Sudan before 1914: red with one crescent/star, same design as Ottoman flag. Reuses full design; does not assert Ottoman administration of Sudan.

sudan_joint_authority_1899.evidence_note: Article II requires joint British/Egyptian flags. Stacked panels are a presentation composition, never a historical Sudan flag. Suakin exception is not separately represented in this geometry.

swaziland_zar_authority_1894.evidence_note: Full Vierkleur as protecting-power representative. Swazi monarchy and territory were not incorporated into ZAR; wartime practical control is disputed.

rashidi_authority_1900.evidence_note: Clean red/yellow Ha'il / Jabal Shammar associated representative flag. A modern reconstruction, not newly verified as exact for 1900. No lettering or scan content.
rashidi_authority_1900.representative_basis: Historically associated Jabal Shammar representative design; bounded approximate use
rashidi_authority_1900.previous_historical_evidence_note: Contemporary repository image arabia_zwemer_1900_flags.jpg; border, proportions and outlined Arial lettering are approximate.

bahrain_authority_1900.evidence_note: Historical red and white design, straight hoist panel. Source file description notes de facto 1910; exact 1900 proportions/layout unverified. Approximate full historical livery, no modern serrations or national flag assertion.

hadramaut_quaiti_livery_1900.evidence_note: Full red/white Quaiti historical flag reconstruction used as an approximate regional Hadramaut livery. Not a Kathiri national flag, unified Hadramaut state, or assertion of 1900 British protection over Kathiri. No 1939 emblem flag used.
